formattedHtml:
M.safePost(`/hermes/agent/{agent_id}/clone`, {
  parameters: { path: { agent_id: a } },
  requestBody: {
    name:
      x.length === 0
        ? u.formatMessage({
            id: `workspaceAgents.management.duplicateUnnamedName`,
            defaultMessage: `Unnamed agent (Copy)`,
            description: `Default name for a copy of an unnamed Workspace Agent`,
          })
        : u.formatMessage(
            {
              id: `workspaceAgents.management.duplicateName`,
              defaultMessage: `{agentName} (Copy)`,
              description: `Default name for a duplicated Workspace Agent`,
            },
            { agentName: x },
          ),
  },
});
